sn45.48:1.2: sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn45.48:1.3: kimatthiyaṃ āvuso samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha
sn45.48:1.4: anupādāparinibbānatthaṃ kho āvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn45.48:1.5: sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn45.48:1.6: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādā parinibbānāyāti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha
sn45.48:1.7: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyāti.
sn45.48:1.8: katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā ca paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāya.
sn45.48:1.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā anupādāparinibbānāyāti.
sn45.48:1.12: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthāti.
